candidates.review_note: Two segment-tree graphs encode outward and inward interval edges without enumerating every planet per plan. Leaf pairs share zero-cost edges, internal directions remain separated. Dijkstra preserves exact nonnegative shortest paths, O((n+q) log n) graph size.

BFS state contains location and current toggle parity for distinct affected cells. Test destination passability before applying all mechanisms triggered by entering it; repeated targets XOR naturally. Starting state has no toggles, observation is not confused with static wall layout.

Choose initial lane opposite first obstacle. Each change in blocked lane forces one switch in the intervening open integer interval. Taking its earliest feasible position dominates later choices for every future cooldown; extra switches cannot improve feasibility. If interval cannot accommodate the switch, its ending obstacle is the furthest reachable point.

Lazy segment tree stores two adjacent Fibonacci-weighted sums relative to each segment. Fibonacci addition identities merge shifted right sums; closed-form sums of Fibonacci numbers apply range additions. Point assignment replaces leaf after pending propagation. Query merging uses actual returned lengths, giving requested weights starting at1,1, modulo1e9.

Implicit treap represents card order, lazy reversal supports interval mutation, subtree sizes answer rank selection. Each value has a permanent node with parent pointers; before computing its rank, propagate reversal flags down the ancestor chain. Split/merge maintain parent links and detach returned roots. Expected logarithmic operations avoid linear list reversals.

For binary coordinates,2D is linear vertex reward minus nonnegative pair disagreement penalties. Combine asymmetric Bij+Bji, retain diagonal terms, encode positive/negative unary weights and undirected capacities in minimum cut. Empty subset is allowed. Dinic returns exact global maximum, not local coordinate greed.

Unfolding reflections identifies cells by folded residues of x+y and x-y modulo2*gcd(n-1,m-1). Nonattacking maximum equals g+1 invariant classes. Handle multiple input lines through EOF; dimensions count cells, so reflection periods use n-1,m-1.

Enumerate at most7^5 unreadable replacements, parse with explicit multiplication precedence and left-associative addition/subtraction. Enforce unsigned binary literals and every intermediate in0..1024, including literals. Parentheses must contain an operation at their own expression level, disallowing bare parenthesized numbers per supplied grammar. Invalid syntax is rejected without eval.
